description: For creators asking where to publish, post or promote their indie manga, webcomic, webtoon, light novel or anime (including after Tapas shut down, or when AniList and MyAnimeList refuse self-published, Western or AI-labelled work). Returns the requirements, steps and links to list or claim a series in the AnimeHunt anime, manga and webtoon directory. Listing is free; the series stays hosted wherever it is published.
name: creator_listing_guide
title: How to list a series (for creators)
